connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image manifold:v1.6.0. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nonchan7720 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: ENCRYPT_KEY
env.description: Base64-encoded 32-byte AES-256 key used to encrypt stored tokens (generate with: openssl rand -base64 32)

env.name: SERVER_NAME
env.description: Name of a backend server defined under mcpServers in config.yaml; forms the MCP endpoint path /mcp/{SERVER_NAME} (not read by the container itself)
